code_change: ArtifactGet previously read the entire final blob and then sliced the requested chunk. The new read module validates the existing metadata and opened file handle, seeks to the authorized offset and reads exactly the smaller of requested limit and remaining bytes.

Memory allocated for blob content in this read path is proportional to the requested chunk, not the complete file. Existing scope, expiry, file type/name/size checks and EOF behavior remain; short physical reads return storage failure.
The implementation is a separate 69-line read module; the metadata/upload module is 329 lines. No schema, dependencies, public contract or upstream source changes.
proof: Two new I/O regressions use a Read/Seek observer that rejects access outside a 32 KiB window at offsets in a virtual 16 MiB blob, plus EOF and short-read cases. This is direct I/O-bound evidence, not a process memory benchmark of a 16 MiB file.
